nifte.config.title: Nifte Settings
nifte.config.highlight_hostile_mobs.tool: Draw the spectral arrow outline on hostile mobs. Client-side only.
nifte.config.highlight_other_players.too: Draw the spectral arrow outline on other players. Client-side only.
nifte.config.ignore_grass.tooltip: Attack mobs through tall grass and similar plants without breaking them.
nifte.config.quick_use.settings.tooltip: Use items from your hotbar with key binds.
nifte.config.keybind.unbound: No key bound. You can bind this in the Key Binds menu.
nifte.config.keybind.quick_use.unbound: No keys bound. You can bind slots 1–9 in the Key Binds menu.
nifte.config.keybind.quick_use.more: You can bind the remaining slots in the Key Binds menu.
nifte.config.fps.hide_debug: Hide FPS when debug overlay is open
nifte.config.food_hunger: Show hunger restored on food names
nifte.config.shulker_tooltip: Show shulker box contents in tooltips
nifte.config.auto_third_person.tooltip: Switch to third person while flying or riding a mount, then back to first person when you land or dismount.
nifte.config.dynamic_third_person.toolti: In third person, the mouse moves the camera and movement keys aim the player. A aims left, D aims right, W aims forward, and S aims backward relative to the camera.
nifte.config.zoom.fov.tooltip: How far the camera zooms in. Scroll while zoomed to adjust temporarily.
nifte.config.disable_fog.tooltip: Removes terrain, water, lava, and status-effect fog.
nifte.config.lower_fire.tooltip: Moves the first-person fire overlay down when you are on fire, so it covers less of your view.
nifte.config.lower_shield.tooltip: Moves first-person shields down so they cover less of your view.
nifte.config.hide_held_totem.tooltip: Hides the Totem of Undying in first person so it does not block your view.
nifte.config.item_scroll: Move items with scroll wheel in containers
nifte.config.sort: Sort containers with pick block button
nifte.config.container_drag.tooltip: Drag items more smoothly, including depositing stacks while dragging.
nifte.config.drop_confirm.tooltip: Require a second drop press for tools, weapons, enchanted items, or every item.
nifte.config.gui_move: Allow movement while containers are open
nifte.config.bedrock_bridging.tooltip: Place blocks against air at edges, like bridging in Bedrock Edition.
nifte.config.fast_block_placement.toolti: Removes the delay between placements. While holding right-click, only continues placing against the same block face as your first click.
nifte.config.block_restock.tooltip: When the block in your hand runs out, swap in a matching stack from your inventory.
nifte.config.bucket_restock.tooltip: When the liquid bucket in your hand is used up, swap in a matching bucket from your inventory.
nifte.config.auto_elytra.tooltip: Swap to an elytra when you jump in the air, then restore your chestplate when you land.
nifte.config.unlock_recipes: Show all recipes in recipe book
nifte.config.recipe_scroll: Cycle recipe book pages with scroll wheel
nifte.config.recipe_centered: Keep inventory centered when recipe book is open
nifte.config.instant_craft: Instant craft items from recipe book
key.nifte.zoom.tooltip: Hold to zoom the camera. Scroll while zoomed to change FOV.
key.nifte.quick_eat.tooltip: Hold to swap to food, eat, then swap back when you release the key.
